bypass: a module pinned only by another package's tests (own-package rule, owner decision 2026-11-11)
description: The core_sign checks move from //core:core_test to //util:core_test, which lists //core:core directly. A module's mutants run against its own package's tests only, so the core_sign mutants survive although a product test would kill each of them; core_add (own test) and util (own tests) are killed as always. The base witness is the head, so mutants-witness reports the same survivors.
